data_product_name: Reference - RF2. Practice List Size and GP Count
data_product_description: Monitor prescribing and dispensing list sizes for each practice. Compare patient numbers and GP counts. Track monthly updates across England.
data_product_overview:
## Access information

Note that your browser may give you warning that this is part of a data breach. As this is a publicly available user name and password you do not need to take any action and can login using the provided generic user ID and password.

## Data Product Overview
This is a monthly report showing the patient list size for each practice in England, split between prescribing and dispensing patients.

It shows:
- practice name
- practice code
- practice address
- dispensing list size
- prescribing list size
- total list size
- GP count
- GP practice

Reports are updated monthly.

The information NHS Prescription Services hold on practices is supplied to NHS Prescription Services by commissioner / provider organisations, which include clinical commissioning groups, local authorities, commissioning hubs (until November 2014) and provider organisations.

Dispensing list size shows the number of patients registered with a doctor who receive both medical services and dispensing services from their doctor. Not all patients registered with a dispensing doctor are eligible to receive dispensing services.

Prescribing list size shows the number of patients registered with a doctor who receive medical services only.

Some of the 'Practices' listed in the information are not traditional practices. They are other services which the commissioner / provider has set up as a practice, such as specialist units or out of hours services. These non-traditional practices do not have a patient list size or may not have a dedicated GP working for them.  In these situations the commissioner / provider may supply arbitrary numbers such as 1, 2 and 50.

Practices which have closed during the period will be included in the report.
